decision.overall_recommendation: VIX gate is open, so new entries are not blanket-restricted, but this system's own tracked history is a major caution flag: 60 prior ranked picks show only a 3.3% win rate and an average return of -2.97% (avg 3.7 bars to resolution). That track record argues for materially smaller size and tighter management than the clean-looking technical setups here would otherwise suggest. Remember the pullback-reversal screener itself is an unvalidated candidate pattern, not a proven edge — fundamentals and news are doing the real work in this ranking. Favor the names with genuine beat streaks and durable growth (EBAY, CTVA, HAL) over story/momentum names with deteriorating profitability (APLD, RIOT) or structural headwinds (MO, BEAM), and treat the three Energy picks (HAL, WMB, KMI) and two Basic Materials picks (CTVA, DOW) as correlated sector bets rather than fully independent positions. Given the weak historical hit rate, this is a monitor-and-scale-in-small posture rather than a full-conviction batch entry.
